Done. Summary:

- **`out/T3/solution.py`**: loads the 114-tensor fp32 checkpoint from `inputs/base`, casts exactly the 112 named attention/MLP projection matrices to bfloat16 via `.to(torch.bfloat16)`, leaves everything else (including `model.embed_tokens.weight` and `lm_head.weight`) untouched in float32 (verified bit-identical), runs the required assertions (112 bf16 tensors, `q_proj.weight` of layer 0 is bf16, `embed_tokens.weight` is fp32, 114 total tensors) before writing anything, then greedily packs tensors into shards capped at 256 MiB of tensor data — the two 412 MB fp32 tensors each land alone in their own shard since they exceed the cap — and writes `model.safetensors.index.json` with a complete `weight_map`.
- Ran it once; it succeeded, producing 10 shards totaling 114 tensors in `out/T3/`.
- **`out/T3/REPORT.md`**: participant self-report filled in per the template.
